description: A script takes decimals as JSON strings and canonicalizes them.
program: (script {:inputs {:price "decimal.Decimal" :qty "Int" :tax "Option<decimal.Decimal>"}} (let [net (decimal.mul price (decimal.from-int qty))] {:net net :gross (match tax (some t) (decimal.add net t) none net) :shown (decimal.format net 2)}))
